The Rule Book

Two Modes. Zero Excuses.

Client walking in or a meeting on the calendar? That is Meeting Mode, full formal. Just a regular day at your desk? Business casual has you covered. Pick your day.

Formal attire is mandatory for client meetings and external visits. Business casual is fine for internal working days, unless you are told otherwise.

👔 👖 👞 🧥

Men, Formal

  • Formal shirt
  • Formal trousers
  • Formal shoes
  • Blazer or suit, optional, extra polish
Client Ready
🥻 👘 👚 👖

Women, Formal

  • Salwar kameez, kurti or saree
  • Or, formal shirt with trousers or skirt
Client Ready
👕 👖 👟

Men, Business Casual

  • Collared t-shirt
  • Cotton pants or jeans, no rips
  • Sneakers or shoes
Desk Ready
👚 👖 👟

Women, Business Casual

  • Tops, shirts or kurti
  • Jeans, no rips, or cotton pants
  • Sneakers or shoes
Desk Ready
🪪 ID card visible, always
🧼 Clean and ironed, non negotiable
🚫 No offensive prints or slogans
💇 Grooming on point
The Style Lab

Basic Fit Sense, Nobody Taught You This

These are not office rules, HR will not check for these. Just small swaps that take an outfit from "trying" to "put together".

One Print At A Time

Wearing a striped shirt, keep the trousers plain. Two patterns fighting for attention reads as chaos, not style.

Checks Play Solo Too

Same logic for checks. One statement piece does the talking, everything else stays quiet.

Light Meets Dark

Pair a light top with darker trousers, or flip it. All light or all dark can look flat under office lighting.

✅

Belt And Shoes, Same Family

Black shoes want a black belt, brown shoes want brown. Mixing the two is the detail that gives it away.

🧦

Socks Are Not An Afterthought

Match socks to the trouser, not to whatever was on top of the drawer. White sports socks under formals is a hard no.

🧥

One Layer, Instant Upgrade

A blazer over a plain shirt turns business casual into client ready in about ten seconds.

⌚

Less Jewellery, More Impact

One watch and minimal jewellery beats five bracelets and two rings. Let the outfit speak first.

🔥

Iron It, Always

Wrinkled is the fastest way to look like you rushed. Two minutes with an iron fixes most fashion sins.

Build Neutral, Add One Pop

Start with a neutral base, navy, white, grey, beige, black. Then allow exactly one colour that pops. Five loud colours together is a festival outfit, not a desk outfit.

🧵

Pin It Before You Leave

Dupatta pinned, saree pleats sorted, before you're out the door. Fixing the drape all day is not a good use of anyone's time.
